title: Smudgy's Origins
description: A couple new origins I though up for the Origin mod.
body:
Smudgy Origins is an addon for the Origins mod that introduces a coupole new origins that I came up with. There are more planned for the future, so just note that the mod is not complete.
So far the origins consist of:

## Smudge
The Smudge is a mold of paper and ink given life, able to stretch its limbs and retreat into the ink. It has increased reach and fall damage immunity, but is damaged by water and has soft, inky hands. It can use ink sacs and black dye as another food source. Its primary ability, Ink Puddle, allows you to retreat into an Ink Puddle for safety, along with being able to move through blocks.

## Slugcat
A reference to Rain World, the Slugcat is nimble omnivore, both predator and prey. It has increased throwing weapon damage, fall immunity, and silent footsteps, but can't sleep when hungry, gets hungry after sleeping, and has soft hands. It has the ability to eat small mobs after killing them (not including mobs that already drop food, like chickens or rabbits). Its primary ability is its cheek pouch, which acts as extra inventory slots. Its secondary ability is being able to meow, a reference to the Push To Meow mod.

## Zombie
You've come back from the dead, but you aren't the same. Now, you're a Zombie! Being a zombie, you are undead, meaning you take extra damage from the Smite enchantment, are healed by Instant Damage and Poison effects, take damage from Instant Health and Regeneration effects, are immune to drowning, and are neutral to the Wither. You also have 2 extra armor points, green skin, and you burn in the sunlight if you don't wear a helmet.
